package choices

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/reflect/protodesc"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/descriptorpb"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/dynamicpb"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestPresenceRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	var number int32
	original := Coverage{Count: Maybe[int32]{Value: int32(0), Present: true}, Data: Maybe[[]byte]{Value: []byte{}, Present: true}, Updated: Maybe[time.Time]{Value: time.Unix(0, 0).UTC(), Present: true}, Delay: Maybe[time.Duration]{Value: time.Duration(0), Present: true}, Items: []AcmeCertSource{{}, {Email: "a"}}, ByName: map[string]AcmeCertSource{"zero": {}}, Choice: Maybe[CoverageChoiceOneof]{Value: CoverageChoiceOneof{Number: &number}, Present: true}}
	wire, err := original.EncodeChecked()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	decoded, err := DecodeCoverage(wire)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if v, ok := decoded.Count.Value, decoded.Count.Present; !ok || v != 0 {
		t.Fatal("lost present zero")
	}
	if v, ok := decoded.Data.Value, decoded.Data.Present; !ok || len(v) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("lost present empty bytes")
	}
	if v, ok := decoded.Updated.Value, decoded.Updated.Present; !ok || !v.Equal(time.Unix(0, 0)) {
		t.Fatal("lost epoch timestamp")
	}
	if v, ok := decoded.Delay.Value, decoded.Delay.Present; !ok || v != 0 {
		t.Fatal("lost zero duration")
	}
	if len(decoded.Items) != 2 || decoded.Items[0].Email != "" || decoded.Items[1].Email != "a" {
		t.Fatal("changed repeated positions")
	}
	if _, ok := decoded.ByName["zero"]; !ok {
		t.Fatal("lost zero map message")
	}
	c, ok := decoded.Choice.Value, decoded.Choice.Present
	if !ok || c.Number == nil || *c.Number != 0 {
		t.Fatal("lost selected zero")
	}
	absent, err := DecodeCoverage(nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if absent.Count.Present || absent.Data.Present || absent.Updated.Present || absent.Delay.Present || absent.Choice.Present {
		t.Fatal("absence became presence")
	}
}
func TestChoiceValidationAndWrapper(t *testing.T) {
	c := CertSource{}
	if _, err := c.EncodeChecked(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("empty required choice accepted")
	}
	c.Value = CertSourceValueOneof{Acme: &AcmeCertSource{}}
	if _, err := c.EncodeChecked(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	config := HttpsConfig{CertSource: Maybe[CertSource]{Value: c, Present: true}}
	d, err := DecodeHttpsConfig(config.Encode())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	inner, ok := d.CertSource.Value, d.CertSource.Present
	if !ok || inner.Value.Acme == nil {
		t.Fatal("wrapper changed")
	}
	x := Coverage{Choice: Maybe[CoverageChoiceOneof]{Value: CoverageChoiceOneof{}, Present: true}}
	if x.Validate() == nil {
		t.Fatal("present empty choice accepted")
	}
	zero := int32(0)
	x.Choice = Maybe[CoverageChoiceOneof]{Value: CoverageChoiceOneof{Number: &zero, Acme: &AcmeCertSource{}}, Present: true}
	if _, err := x.EncodeChecked(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("multiple alternatives accepted")
	}

	defer func() {
		if recover() == nil {
			t.Fatal("Encode silently accepted invalid choice")
		}
	}()
	x.Encode()
}
func TestChoiceMergeAndLastWins(t *testing.T) {
	a := AcmeCertSource{Email: "first", Domains: []string{"a"}}
	b := AcmeCertSource{Domains: []string{"b"}}
	wire := AppendBytesElem(nil, a.Encode(), 8)
	wire = AppendBytesElem(wire, b.Encode(), 8)
	got, err := DecodeCoverage(wire)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	c, _ := got.Choice.Value, got.Choice.Present
	if c.Acme == nil || c.Acme.Email != "first" || len(c.Acme.Domains) != 2 {
		t.Fatal("same alternative failed to merge")
	}
	wire = AppendInt32Elem(wire, 0, 9)
	got, err = DecodeCoverage(wire)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	c, _ = got.Choice.Value, got.Choice.Present
	if c.Acme != nil || c.Number == nil || *c.Number != 0 {
		t.Fatal("different alternative did not replace")
	}
	wire = AppendBytesElem(wire, b.Encode(), 8)
	got, err = DecodeCoverage(wire)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	c, _ = got.Choice.Value, got.Choice.Present
	if c.Acme == nil || c.Acme.Email != "" || len(c.Acme.Domains) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("old cleared alternative resurrected")
	}
}
func TestUnknownFields(t *testing.T) {
	unknown := AppendBytesElem(nil, []byte("future"), 99)
	wire := AppendInt32Elem(nil, 0, 9)
	wire = append(wire, unknown...)
	got, err := DecodeCoverage(wire)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(got.UnknownFields(), unknown) {
		t.Fatal("unknown lost")
	}
	copy := got.UnknownFields()
	copy[0] = 0
	if !bytes.Equal(got.UnknownFields(), unknown) {
		t.Fatal("unknown storage exposed")
	}
	again, err := DecodeCoverage(got.Encode())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(again.UnknownFields(), unknown) {
		t.Fatal("unknown lost on reencode")
	}
	future, err := DecodeCoverage(unknown)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if future.Choice.Present {
		t.Fatal("unknown field guessed as choice")
	}
	if _, err := DecodeCoverage([]byte{0x42, 0x80}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("malformed wire accepted")
	}
}
func TestJSONPresence(t *testing.T) {
	x := HttpsConfig{Enabled: Maybe[bool]{Value: false, Present: true}}
	data, err := json.Marshal(x)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if string(data) != `{"enabled":false}` {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected JSON %s", data)
	}
	var got HttpsConfig
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &got); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if v, ok := got.Enabled.Value, got.Enabled.Present; !ok || v {
		t.Fatal("lost JSON presence")
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"enabled":null}`), &got); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got.Enabled.Present {
		t.Fatal("JSON null not absent")
	}
}
func TestRecursivePresence(t *testing.T) {
	x := Node{Next: Maybe[*Node]{Value: &Node{}, Present: true}, Children: []Node{{}}}
	got, err := DecodeNode(x.Encode())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if v, ok := got.Next.Value, got.Next.Present; !ok || v == nil {
		t.Fatal("recursive presence lost")
	}
	x.Next = Maybe[*Node]{Present: true}
	if x.Validate() == nil {
		t.Fatal("present nil recursive message accepted")
	}
}
func TestRequiredMeansPresence(t *testing.T) {
	x := RequiredFields{Count: Maybe[int32]{Value: int32(0), Present: true}}
	if err := x.Validate(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	x.Count = Maybe[int32]{}
	if x.Validate() == nil {
		t.Fatal("missing required optional accepted")
	}
}

func TestAuditChoiceAndPresence(t *testing.T) {
	secret := SecretCertSource{Name: "visible", Secret: []byte("hidden")}
	x := HttpsConfig{CertSource: Maybe[CertSource]{Value: CertSource{Value: CertSourceValueOneof{Secret: &secret}}, Present: true}}
	projected := x.ToAudit()
	data, err := json.Marshal(projected)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if bytes.Contains(data, []byte("hidden")) || bytes.Contains(data, []byte("aGlkZGVu")) {
		t.Fatalf("audit leaked secret %s", data)
	}
	if !bytes.Contains(data, []byte("visible")) {
		t.Fatalf("audit dropped label %s", data)
	}
	outer, ok := projected.CertSource.Value, projected.CertSource.Present
	if !ok || outer.Value.Secret == nil {
		t.Fatal("audit lost choice presence")
	}
}
func TestPresentZeroTime(t *testing.T) {
	x := Coverage{Updated: Maybe[time.Time]{Value: time.Time{}, Present: true}}
	got, err := DecodeCoverage(x.Encode())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	v, ok := got.Updated.Value, got.Updated.Present
	if !ok || !v.IsZero() {
		t.Fatalf("zero time changed: %v %v", v, ok)
	}
}

func TestScalarChoiceAndNativeMerge(t *testing.T) {
	flag, text, status, updated, delay := false, "", Status(999), time.Time{}, time.Duration(0)
	var data []byte
	tests := []ScalarChoiceValueOneof{ScalarChoiceValueOneof{Flag: &flag}, ScalarChoiceValueOneof{Text: &text}, ScalarChoiceValueOneof{Data: &data}, ScalarChoiceValueOneof{Status: &status}, ScalarChoiceValueOneof{Updated: &updated}, ScalarChoiceValueOneof{Delay: &delay}}
	for _, choice := range tests {
		x := ScalarChoice{Value: Maybe[ScalarChoiceValueOneof]{Value: choice, Present: true}}
		got, err := DecodeScalarChoice(x.Encode())
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		c, ok := got.Value.Value, got.Value.Present
		if !ok || (c.Flag == nil) != (choice.Flag == nil) || (c.Text == nil) != (choice.Text == nil) || (c.Data == nil) != (choice.Data == nil) || (c.Status == nil) != (choice.Status == nil) || (c.Updated == nil) != (choice.Updated == nil) || (c.Delay == nil) != (choice.Delay == nil) {
			t.Fatal("lost scalar selection")
		}
	}
	seconds := AppendInt64Elem(nil, 100, 1)
	nanos := AppendInt32Elem(nil, 123, 2)
	wire := AppendBytesElem(nil, seconds, 5)
	wire = AppendBytesElem(wire, nanos, 5)
	got, err := DecodeScalarChoice(wire)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	c, _ := got.Value.Value, got.Value.Present
	if c.Updated == nil || !c.Updated.Equal(time.Unix(100, 123)) {
		t.Fatal("native message failed to merge")
	}
}
func TestPackedMergeUnknownEnumAndIgnored(t *testing.T) {
	a := Packed{Values: []int32{1, 2}}
	b := Packed{Values: []int32{3}}
	wire := append(a.Encode(), b.Encode()...)
	wire = AppendInt32Elem(wire, 4, 1)
	wire = AppendInt32Elem(wire, 999, 2)
	wire = AppendInt32Elem(wire, 123, 3)
	got, err := DecodePacked(wire)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(got.Values) != 4 || got.Values[3] != 4 {
		t.Fatal("multiple packed/unpacked chunks lost")
	}
	if v, ok := got.State.Value, got.State.Present; !ok || v != 999 {
		t.Fatal("unknown numeric enum lost")
	}
	if len(got.UnknownFields()) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("ignored field preserved as unknown")
	}
	again, err := DecodePacked(got.Encode())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if v, ok := again.State.Value, again.State.Present; !ok || v != 999 {
		t.Fatal("unknown numeric enum lost on reencode")
	}
}
func TestAuditCollections(t *testing.T) {
	secret := SecretCertSource{Name: "visible", Secret: []byte("hidden")}
	x := AuditCollections{Single: Maybe[SecretCertSource]{Value: secret, Present: true}, Values: []SecretCertSource{secret}, Pointers: []*SecretCertSource{&secret, nil}, ByName: map[string]SecretCertSource{"s": secret}, Required: secret}
	out := x.ToAudit()
	data, err := json.Marshal(out)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if bytes.Contains(data, []byte("aGlkZGVu")) {
		t.Fatal("secret leaked")
	}
	if len(out.Values) != 1 || out.Values[0].Name != "visible" || len(out.Pointers) != 2 || out.Pointers[1] != nil || out.ByName["s"].Name != "visible" {
		t.Fatal("audit changed collection shape")
	}
}
func TestJSONPresentNilBytes(t *testing.T) {
	data, err := json.Marshal(Coverage{Data: Maybe[[]byte]{Present: true}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var got Coverage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &got); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if v, ok := got.Data.Value, got.Data.Present; !ok || len(v) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("JSON lost present nil bytes")
	}
}

// Compare our decoder/encoder with the standard protobuf runtime, independently
// of our generated code's own round-trip behavior.
func TestStandardProtobufOneofCompatibility(t *testing.T) {
	optional := descriptorpb.FieldDescriptorProto_LABEL_OPTIONAL
	repeated := descriptorpb.FieldDescriptorProto_LABEL_REPEATED
	str := descriptorpb.FieldDescriptorProto_TYPE_STRING
	msg := descriptorpb.FieldDescriptorProto_TYPE_MESSAGE
	fd, err := protodesc.NewFile(&descriptorpb.FileDescriptorProto{
		Name: proto.String("oracle.proto"), Package: proto.String("oracle"), Syntax: proto.String("proto3"),
		MessageType: []*descriptorpb.DescriptorProto{
			{Name: proto.String("Child"), Field: []*descriptorpb.FieldDescriptorProto{
				{Name: proto.String("label"), Number: proto.Int32(1), Type: &str, Label: &optional},
				{Name: proto.String("items"), Number: proto.Int32(2), Type: &str, Label: &repeated},
			}},
			{Name: proto.String("Root"), OneofDecl: []*descriptorpb.OneofDescriptorProto{{Name: proto.String("value")}}, Field: []*descriptorpb.FieldDescriptorProto{
				{Name: proto.String("acme"), Number: proto.Int32(1), Type: &msg, Label: &optional, TypeName: proto.String(".oracle.Child"), OneofIndex: proto.Int32(0)},
				{Name: proto.String("secret"), Number: proto.Int32(2), Type: &msg, Label: &optional, TypeName: proto.String(".oracle.Child"), OneofIndex: proto.Int32(0)},
			}},
		},
	}, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	a := AcmeCertSource{Email: "a", Domains: []string{"x"}}
	b := AcmeCertSource{Domains: []string{"y"}}
	first := AppendBytesElem(nil, a.Encode(), 1)
	merged := AppendBytesElem(bytes.Clone(first), b.Encode(), 1)
	replaced := AppendBytesElem(bytes.Clone(merged), AppendStringElem(nil, "secret", 1), 2)
	unknown := AppendInt32Elem(bytes.Clone(first), 77, 99)
	cases := [][]byte{AppendBytesElem(nil, nil, 1), first, merged, replaced, AppendBytesElem(bytes.Clone(replaced), b.Encode(), 1), unknown}
	for _, wire := range cases {
		want := dynamicpb.NewMessage(fd.Messages().ByName("Root"))
		if err := proto.Unmarshal(wire, want); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		ours, err := DecodeCertSource(wire)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		encoded, err := ours.EncodeChecked()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		actual := dynamicpb.NewMessage(want.Descriptor())
		if err := proto.Unmarshal(encoded, actual); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if !proto.Equal(want, actual) {
			t.Fatalf("protobuf mismatch: want %s, got %s", want, actual)
		}
	}
}

func TestCyclicGraphRejected(t *testing.T) {
	n := &Node{}
	n.Next = Maybe[*Node]{Value: n, Present: true}
	if _, err := n.EncodeChecked(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("cyclic graph accepted")
	}
	if _, err := json.Marshal(n); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("cyclic JSON accepted")
	}
}

func TestJSONSelectedNilBytes(t *testing.T) {
	var dataValue []byte
	x := ScalarChoice{Value: Maybe[ScalarChoiceValueOneof]{Value: ScalarChoiceValueOneof{Data: &dataValue}, Present: true}}
	data, err := json.Marshal(x)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var got ScalarChoice
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &got); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	choice, ok := got.Value.Value, got.Value.Present
	if !ok || choice.Data == nil || len(*choice.Data) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("selected bytes lost: %s", data)
	}
}

func TestConstraintsAndIgnoredChoice(t *testing.T) {
	emptyText, validText := "", "ok"
	var number int32
	x := Constrained{}
	if err := x.Validate(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	x.Count = Maybe[int32]{Value: int32(0), Present: true}
	if x.Validate() == nil {
		t.Fatal("numeric constraint ignored")
	}
	x.Count = Maybe[int32]{Value: int32(1), Present: true}
	x.State = Maybe[Status]{Value: Status(999), Present: true}
	if x.Validate() == nil {
		t.Fatal("defined-only enum constraint ignored")
	}
	x.State = Maybe[Status]{Value: Status_STATUS_READY, Present: true}
	x.Value = Maybe[ConstrainedValueOneof]{Value: ConstrainedValueOneof{Text: &emptyText}, Present: true}
	if x.Validate() == nil {
		t.Fatal("selected string constraint ignored")
	}
	x.Value = Maybe[ConstrainedValueOneof]{Value: ConstrainedValueOneof{Number: &number}, Present: true}
	if x.Validate() == nil {
		t.Fatal("selected number constraint ignored")
	}
	x.Value = Maybe[ConstrainedValueOneof]{Value: ConstrainedValueOneof{Text: &validText}, Present: true}
	if err := x.Validate(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	wire := AppendInt32Elem(nil, 1, 9)
	wire = AppendStringElem(wire, "ignored", 12)
	got, err := DecodeCoverage(wire)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got.Choice.Present {
		t.Fatal("ignored alternative did not clear preceding choice")
	}
}

func TestAbsentPublicValueIsIgnored(t *testing.T) {
	number := int32(9)
	x := Coverage{
		Count:  Maybe[int32]{Value: 42},
		Choice: Maybe[CoverageChoiceOneof]{Value: CoverageChoiceOneof{Number: &number, Acme: &AcmeCertSource{}}},
	}
	wire, err := x.EncodeChecked()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	got, err := DecodeCoverage(wire)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got.Count.Present || got.Choice.Present {
		t.Fatal("absent payload was encoded")
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(x)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if bytes.Contains(data, []byte(`"count"`)) || bytes.Contains(data, []byte(`"choice"`)) {
		t.Fatalf("absent payload reached JSON: %s", data)
	}
	// Toggling presence directly must restore validation of the same payload.
	x.Choice.Present = true
	if x.Validate() == nil {
		t.Fatal("present ambiguous choice accepted")
	}
	x.Choice.Value.Acme = nil
	if err := x.Validate(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	x.Choice.Value.Number = nil
	if x.Validate() == nil {
		t.Fatal("present empty choice accepted")
	}
	// A stale recursive payload must also be ignored while absent.
	cycle := &Node{}
	cycle.Next = Maybe[*Node]{Value: cycle, Present: true}
	root := Node{Next: Maybe[*Node]{Value: cycle}}
	if _, err := root.EncodeChecked(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := json.Marshal(root); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	required := RequiredFields{Count: Maybe[int32]{Value: 42}}
	if required.Validate() == nil {
		t.Fatal("stale value satisfied required presence")
	}
}
